snippet.title: The Great Flood - Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
The Great Flood is a free-to-play, action-packed real-time strategy game featuring PvE and PvP gameplay. With 50+ mythical characters to choose from, players build a squad of ten, comprised of two powerful heroes and eight diverse soldiers. Deploy your team, change tactics mid-battle, place defensive towers and fight until victorious! 

The Great Flood is out now for Meta Quest: https://www.meta.com/en-gb/experiences/the-great-flood/25044401601879310/
